candidate_relations.reason: Sebaceous carcinoma is a different periocular adnexal malignancy and was not described on the excisional biopsy.

candidate_relations.reason: Basal cell carcinoma with squamous cell carcinoma describes the same mixed object as basosquamous carcinoma in this plaque-plus-papule course.
Labeling only the residual papules as BCC ignores the original invasive squamous plaque that defined the mixed tumor.
